title: Run Your First Factory
description: Run a packaged factory end to end without writing any configuration.
openingSummary: Packaged factories ship ready to run, so the shortest path to seeing you-agent-factory work is to run one someone else already wrote.

whatItIs.title: What It Is
whatItIs.body: A packaged factory is a complete, published workflow you can run by name. You supply a goal; the factory supplies the graph, the workers, and the review steps.

whenToUse.title: When To Use
whenToUse.body: Use this right after installing, before writing anything of your own. Running a packaged factory proves your install works and shows you the shape of a factory run.

stepsOrWorkflow.title: Steps Or Workflow
stepsOrWorkflow.body: Pick a packaged factory, run it against a goal, then watch the session until it settles.

commonPitfalls.title: Common Pitfalls
commonPitfalls.body: A packaged factory still needs a harness to drive it. If the run exits immediately, check that your provider credentials are set and that the session actually started.
